{Room, ArtifactPointer}:
  for records r1 != r2 of m with r1.request_id and r2.request_id present:
    r1.request_id != r2.request_id
create(m, request_id = k, facts = f) where existing r of m has r.request_id = k:
  a check of stages (1) to (4) of A04 rule 6 fails, or m in   -- A01-2

statements:

{Room, ArtifactPointer}:

create(m, request_id = k, facts = f) where existing r of m has r.request_id = k:
  a check of stages (1) to (4) of A04 rule 6 fails, or m in   -- A01-2

verdicts.why: The check detects whether an equal retry creates another pointer, changes any stored row, increments the version, or supersedes the original. It also retries after the original has become superseded and verifies that the same pointer and version are returned unchanged.
